TODO(initiator): every value. boost_capacitor as in ship.json (drain_time, recharge_time, recharge_delay s, start_charge, strength_curve (charge, share of the full boost), restart_while_held); boost_thrust: multipliers on the thrust per direction at full boost (the brake always gets them). spool_delay: s per thruster group (main forward, retro backward, vertical up and down, lateral left and right) that a fresh request waits before thrust; a running boost skips it; the timer resets when the request returns to zero. jerk: m/s³ per group, how fast a group's thrust may change (time to full = spool + full/jerk). angular_jerk: rad/s³ per pitch, yaw, roll. boost_pre_delay: s from the press to the boost start; boost_ramp_up / boost_ramp_down: s to full strength after the start, and to none after release. boost_counter_share: 0..1, countering boost (against the velocity on an axis) gets this share of the aligned boost at full boost; unboosted countering is the plain box. idle_cost: charge 0..1 per s drained while boost is held, with or without thrust, on top of the capacitor's drain.
